blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: The children's area is over there.
exercises.why: **уголок** — уголок: small corner (part or region); nook. Wiktionary: у́гол + -о́к.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **водку** — во́дка: (usually, uncountable) vodka; (dated) flavored liquor, liqueur; (pharmacology, obsolete) tincture (a solution of some substance in alcohol for use in medicine or cosmetics); (chemistry, archaic) aqua, acid. Wiktionary: вода́ + -ка.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **картинки** — карти́нка: a small picture, photograph or illustration; icon. Wiktionary: карти́на + -ка.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **дедушка** — де́душка: (slang) top of the house, ninety in the lotto game. Wiktionary: дед + -ушка.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: a small picture, photograph or illustration; icon
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: уголок — small corner (part or region); глазок — (colloquial): little eye; во́дка — (usually, uncountable) vodka; карти́нка — a small picture, photograph or illustration; icon.
